note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its source. Four trophies have no confirmed unlock method at launch and say so honestly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion), so work the roadmap in order: finish the story first, then the 100% checklist, then the Strangers & Freaks cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, all offline, with one playthrough enough.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It cannot be missed — just play the story and it pops when the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 1. It pops when you complete the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag? Nothing to do but play through the story.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 2. It pops when you complete the first mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City. The asterisks in the name are how PlayStation publishes it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: finish Chapter 4. It pops after the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero. No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the final mission. After the credits you keep free-roaming Leonida, so finish the story first and do the cleanup afterwards — nothing in the 100% checklist is missable.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy: complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. It pops as part of the story and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. Finish the story to unlock the 100% Completion checklist (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion); progress made during the story already counts. The checklist is lenient — roughly 60% of true completion: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 card sets, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and all 15 Target Decks. Nothing on it is missable; everything can be done in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridges, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — mix the categories however you like. Under-the-bridges runs (flying a plane under bridges) are the quickest to rack up. Track progress at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find spots at Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going after this pops.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. The tracker counts 9 types (Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities); most unlock naturally while you chase the other trophies, so check what is left and do that one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero (find them at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges). Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear, and some stay locked until you meet other conditions shown on the map. Track progress at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Find every location at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Drones, then Top Fun Drones.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race twice does not count. Race locations appear as you explore Leonida; track them all at Touch Pad, then Activities, then Racing. Most locations let you hire a car; if you bring your own, watch its Rating and buy upgrades at Mod Shops first.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you about a fishing challenge and marks a spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his questline: he asks for a Parrotfish over 2 kg, so fish in the marked area until you land one that size. You need a boat with a fishing rod — hijack one nearby if you do not own one.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You must finish all the levels of one game at least once — beating every challenge is not required, so pick the one you like best.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's optional questline (Lucia only). It starts in Chapter 3 when Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. Complete all 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of Andy's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It starts in Chapter 1 after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton): he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — find the chests on the ocean floor with the metal detector and bring them back. Kenton goes away for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so the trophy is not missable. Track progress at Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Complete all 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops after the last one. All of Billy's quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Only certain questlines count — Andy, Billy, Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani and Eddie do not count as strangers. Strands confirmed to count include Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries); more are still being found. All strangers stay available in free roam after the story, and your count shows in the trophy list.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's Wish List. It starts after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is on the list, and watch Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. Still doable after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline (Jason only). It starts after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City, which you destroy in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This, and the trophy pops when you shut the labs down. All of it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at one spot counts twice. Track progress at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks to the balcony at Jason's house — follow her and choose Accept. That session may be required (still unconfirmed) and it is gone after Chapter 1, so do it when it appears and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County (Jason only). Do it, and Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. It stays available after the story; PowerPyx notes the exact animal that pops the trophy is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Track progress at Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward the sets. The 100% checklist needs 15 sets, so this pops early on the way there.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up, then R1 to scan): 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — well over 100 exist, so scan any mix you come across. Track progress at Progress, then Collections, then WAiNK Locations.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges (the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way). View them all at Progress, then Challenges. Most complete naturally while you chase the other trophies; save the hardest for last and pick the easiest remaining ones to finish.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, lose a 4-star wanted level and escape the heat. Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle). Build 4 stars, then escape: a fast sports motorcycle cutting through traffic works, or drive the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone. It also pops naturally while robbing the large bank vaults in Chapter 4, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level. Call your partner (hold Right, then Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) while staying wanted — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level, not the solid red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing (Zombix or Adrenaline). A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each, break the safe with sticky bombs, and if it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the pop is delayed by about 30 seconds.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles (557 exist at launch: cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes). The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning counts, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. Track progress at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 scanned, so keep going.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3+R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time and drains the purple focus bar. Buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline (hold L1, then Triangle), wear body armor, and use an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 enemies at a gang operation and drop them fast — it does not seem to count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots; at Focus level 4 this gets much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — planes sitting on the open airfield do not count. The easiest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge and enter the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops (slightly delayed).

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino). Find them at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — the tanks stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and jewelry store robberies appear as green icons. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (kicking the door trips the alarm), find the note with the safe code in the back room, and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape (the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way). First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe): tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans (purple icons) — you need his earlier Payday Loans quests done first. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level; escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognized. Up to $205,000 per bank.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing the bank vault counts as robbing the armored truck. Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the entire map is visible. It pairs naturally with the stunt and vehicle-scanning grind, so save it for the cleanup phase.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs (39 operations exist; the 100% checklist needs all of them). Operations appear as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked automatically through the story. Track how many you have robbed per gang at Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown. The description points to a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the likely spot is a bar or venue overlooking Ocean Beach in Vice City; check the linked guide for updates as players pin it down. Do not chase a rumoured method: nothing is confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy). Hack into the Banshee, drive forward through the window, and the trophy pops shortly after (slightly delayed). Only the blue Banshee counts, not any other car.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Inside: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation). The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. The three items need not be stolen in one visit — if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later and you can go back for it, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Only possible after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at fitness clubs (filter Map, then Activities) — always bring your partner along (hold Right, then Triangle to call them), because while one character trains, the other completes their training too, doubling progress. Check strength at Touch Pad, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (heart icon). You can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile — the trophy list itself tracks the count (open the trophy to see it). Turn on notifications at Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile, so a demon-face icon shows whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable — avoid Irredeemable, it is permanent and makes police shoot on sight. It accrues passively through robberies and fights; if it is the last one left, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. 'Second time's the charm' suggests failing something once and succeeding on the retry. Treat the Payday Loans link as unconfirmed: check the linked guide for updates rather than grinding a guess.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be tied to a UFO questline. The description ('What the hell just happened?') points to a strange encounter somewhere in Leonida. Until a guide confirms the steps, treat any UFO method as a rumour and check the linked guide for updates.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be about knocking enemies over with a melee drive-by (kicking them while riding a motorcycle). Try melee kicks from a moving bike at enemies on foot, but treat that as unconfirmed — check the linked guide for updates.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts — it counts across all robberies, not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while doing the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — any shops count. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the priciest and fastest; clothing, footwear, hair & beauty, electronics, Pay 'n' Sprays and Mod Shops all count too. Find shops on the map at Touch Pad, then Style.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses). Prices: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each garage adds storage you can register vehicles into for Scooter Bros.

source.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app, installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register — initially he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes; buy garages first, since each adds parking spots.
